title.rendered: Updated Information for Registration Events at LRMS

content.rendered:
We are
sending out some updated information in regards to our Registration Night and
Open House. We hope that this clears up some confusion from the summer
letter. We will have stations set up for you to visit and you can see
those stations below.

Registration Open House at Laurel
Ridge Middle School (for ALL
grades)

  • August 23rd:
    4:00 – 7:00 p.m.
  • August 24th:
    9:00 – 2:00 p.m.

ParentVue and Demographic Changes will be handed out in student folders, with their schedules. You
will pick these up at station 1.

Student Fees &
Payments: Student fees will
be collected at Registration Night and Open House prior to issuing student
schedules. Only cash or checks are accepted onsite. At this time, we will not be
collecting Chromebook fees until after the start of the school year. Fees
will be collected at station 1.

Locker Assignments: 8th Grade students will be able to sign up for locker partners at
Registration events. They will not be pre-assigned. Students will not be able to
request locker placements. We are looking for volunteers to share
lockers, as we do not have enough lockers for all of our students. Please see station
2 to sign up.

Medication Drop-Off: Our
nurse, Jerilyn Wernet, will be available tonight to receive medication from 4
pm -7 pm. Please stop by station 2 to fill out medication forms.

We look forward to seeing you at one
of our registration events and we hope that you are enjoying these final days
of summer.
